name: grobys-deck

scripts.lint: eslint src features public/core integrations scripts packages && node scripts/lint-html-scripts.js

scripts.verify:health: npm run format:check && npm run lint && node scripts/audit-repository-health.js && node scripts/verify-source-structure.js && npm run verify:generated
